notes: Blue-Story Bootstrap.cs can check SHA-256 of pinned dependencies and guards extracted paths but the source update ZIP is downloaded without an expected hash; this does NOT imply Unova content/install authenticity.
G07.2 does not register a Unova installer in scripts/install_game.py, Bootstrap.cs, Android update_client.py, or any downloadable release.
Only artificial documentation payload bytes in memory and a synthetic origin manifest are accepted. SHA-256 integrity checks do not authenticate the author or grant rights.
All files require explicit rights declarations with redistribution_approved false. Missing rights or claims of native release are rejected even when SHA checks pass.
Version, source revision, target revision, SHA-256 of origin manifest, source file bytes, destination bytes, destination paths and all metadata are validated before constructing a simulated preview.
No filesystem writing, ZIP extraction, download, Game.exe, JoiPlay, saves or MapID changes. Source manifest is an in-memory fixture.
A12 static analysis does not grant MapID ownership or physical installation proof. G07.3 will test compare-and-swap and rollback in separate offline fixtures.
